{{Quote|We can't identify the financier himself, but your information shows he's visited House Organa, House Serrus, House Panteer&hellip; and House Cortess.|Vector Hyllus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''House Serrus''' was one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Denri Ayl]] visited House Serrus along with a number of other houses in his work as a negotiator.
